command.label: Overwatch
command.instructions: A calm, controlled American woman working a tactical operations radio net at night. Clipped, economical, low and level; she never raises her voice, even when the news is bad. Radio procedure cadence, slight urgency on orders.

squad1.label: Nightcell operator
squad1.instructions: An American special operations soldier on a squad radio in the middle of a firefight. Tight, fast, breathing slightly hard, clear enough to understand. No shouting into the mic, just urgent and professional.

squad2.label: Nightcell operator
squad2.instructions: A second American operator on a squad radio in combat, lower voice than his teammate, terse and controlled, a little gravel. Urgent but clear.

command.label: Command
command.instructions: A senior operations officer on a military radio net at night: calm, deliberate, authoritative, measured pace. Neutral English, no put-on accent. Slight urgency on orders.

squad1.label: Directorate trooper
squad1.instructions: A soldier on a squad radio in the middle of a firefight. Fast, tight, breathing a little hard, professional. Neutral English, no put-on accent.

squad2.label: Directorate trooper
squad2.instructions: A second soldier on a squad radio in combat, terse and controlled, slightly higher and sharper than his teammate. Neutral English, no put-on accent.

order_move_out.speaker: command
order_move_out.text: All Nightcell elements, you are clear to move. Take the yard.

order_push_hardpoint.speaker: command
order_push_hardpoint.text: push the hardpoint. It's the high ground in the middle, take it.

order_push_west.speaker: command
order_push_west.text: they're thin on the west side. Push the pipe rack.

order_push_east.speaker: command
order_push_east.text: east side is open. Move up through tank row.

order_hold_hardpoint.speaker: command
order_hold_hardpoint.text: you have the centre. Hold the hardpoint, let them come to you.

order_fall_back.speaker: command
order_fall_back.text: you're taking too many losses. Fall back to the containers and regroup.

order_catwalk.speaker: command
order_catwalk.text: get eyes up on the west catwalk. I want that height.

order_gantry.speaker: command
order_gantry.text: take the east gantry. Watch the lanes from up there.

order_last_one.speaker: command
order_last_one.text: one hostile left in the yard. Finish it.

order_good_work.speaker: command
order_good_work.text: good work. Keep that pressure on.

order_back_in.speaker: command
order_back_in.text: you're back in. Rejoin the squad and keep moving.

contact_gantry_b.speaker: squad2
contact_gantry_b.text: Shooter up on the east gantry!

contact_south_containers_b.speaker: squad2
contact_south_containers_b.text: They're in the south containers, close!

contact_north_gate_b.speaker: squad2
contact_north_gate_b.text: More of them coming out the north gate!

contact_yard_gate_a.speaker: squad1
contact_yard_gate_a.text: Contact at the yard gate, behind us!

contact_yard_gate_b.speaker: squad2
contact_yard_gate_b.text: Hostiles at our own gate, behind us!

grenade_b.speaker: squad2
grenade_b.text: Frag out, frag out, get clear!

chatter_01.speaker: command
chatter_01.text: All elements, Overwatch. Check your sectors.

chatter_04.speaker: squad2
chatter_04.text: Three, ammo check. I'm on my last two mags.

chatter_05.speaker: command
chatter_05.text: Overwatch, all elements. Drone feed is down, you're on your own eyes.

chatter_06.speaker: squad1
chatter_06.text: Nothing moving on the gantry. Watching it.

chatter_07.speaker: squad2
chatter_07.text: Say again, Overwatch, you're breaking up.

chatter_08.speaker: command
chatter_08.text: I say again. Stay off the open ground.

chatter_09.speaker: squad1
chatter_09.text: Floodlights on the east side just went out.

chatter_10.speaker: command
chatter_10.text: Be advised, their comms are active. Assume they can hear you.

chatter_12.speaker: squad1
chatter_12.text: I have you covered. Move now.

chatter_13.speaker: command
chatter_13.text: Overwatch copies all. Time is not on our side, keep moving.

chatter_14.speaker: squad2
chatter_14.text: Two, you hear that? Something up on the catwalk.

order_move_out.speaker: command
order_move_out.text: All units, this is Command. You are cleared to advance. Secure the yard.

order_push_hardpoint.speaker: command
order_push_hardpoint.text: advance on the hardpoint. Whoever holds the centre holds the yard.

order_push_west.speaker: command
order_push_west.text: the west side is weak. Take your team up the pipe rack.

order_push_east.speaker: command
order_push_east.text: the east lane is clear. Advance through tank row.

order_hold_hardpoint.speaker: command
order_hold_hardpoint.text: the centre is ours. Hold the hardpoint. Make them come to you.

order_fall_back.speaker: command
order_fall_back.text: casualties are too high. Fall back to the containers and regroup.

order_catwalk.speaker: command
order_catwalk.text: put someone on the west catwalk. I want eyes up high.

order_gantry.speaker: command
order_gantry.text: take the east gantry and cover the lanes from above.

order_last_one.speaker: command
order_last_one.text: one intruder left in the yard. Find him and end this.

order_back_in.speaker: command
order_back_in.text: you're back on the line. Rejoin your team and advance.

contact_north_containers_b.speaker: squad2
contact_north_containers_b.text: They're in the north containers, close!

contact_north_gate_a.speaker: squad1
contact_north_gate_a.text: Contact at the north gate, behind us!

contact_yard_gate_b.speaker: squad2
contact_yard_gate_b.text: More coming through the yard gate!

man_down_a.speaker: squad2
man_down_a.text: Man down! We have a man down!

chatter_01.speaker: command
chatter_01.text: All units, Command. Report your positions.

chatter_02.speaker: squad1
chatter_02.text: Command, Section One. In position, holding.

chatter_04.speaker: squad2
chatter_04.text: Section Two, low on ammunition. Requesting resupply.

chatter_05.speaker: command
chatter_05.text: All units, be advised. The perimeter cameras are down on the east side.

chatter_06.speaker: squad1
chatter_06.text: Nothing on the gantry. Still watching.

chatter_07.speaker: squad2
chatter_07.text: Command, repeat your last, you are breaking up.

chatter_08.speaker: command
chatter_08.text: I repeat. Stay off the open ground.

chatter_09.speaker: squad1
chatter_09.text: Lights just went out by the tanks.

chatter_10.speaker: command
chatter_10.text: All units. Something is wrong with these orders. Confirm everything twice.

chatter_13.speaker: command
chatter_13.text: Command copies. Hold discipline, nobody fires without a target.

chatter_14.speaker: squad2
chatter_14.text: Did you hear that? Up on the catwalk.
